kyogre-storm-sea.name: Tempest Sea
kyogre-storm-sea.place: a stormy sea at dusk: huge teal and white breaking waves and spray, a dark brown rock crag, a pink-red sunset sky
kyogre-storm-sea.layout: an arena of wave-washed rock shelves in a stormy teal sea: a large central flat wet-rock platform and two side shelves joined by rock causeways, deep churning teal water with white foam around the edges and in channels, dark brown rock crags as obstacles

magmar-volcano.name: Cinder Caldera
magmar-volcano.place: a volcano: a dark red-brown crater slope with bright orange lava rivers and a smoky crimson and violet sky
magmar-volcano.layout: a volcanic crater floor of dark cooled basalt and ash, crossed by a few narrow glowing lava rivers and lava pools, jagged black rock outcrops as obstacles, smoking vents

zarude-jungle.name: Deep Jungle Clearing
zarude-jungle.place: a dense green jungle with thick hanging vines, mossy trunks and dappled light
zarude-jungle.layout: a mossy jungle clearing of packed earth and short moss, walled by giant tree trunks and dense foliage around the edges, a few big trunks and vine thickets inside as cover, patches of tall grass

sableye-crystal-cave.name: Gem Cavern
sableye-crystal-cave.place: a dark violet cave glittering with big pale-blue, teal and purple crystal clusters
sableye-crystal-cave.layout: a cave floor of dark violet stone, enclosed by cave walls, with clusters of glowing blue and purple crystals as obstacles and breakable props, a couple of small dark pools

liepard-night-city.name: Midnight Rooftops
liepard-night-city.place: a city at night: purple-violet skyscrapers, lit windows, a big full moon, a deep indigo sky and warm streetlights
liepard-night-city.layout: a night city plaza and street intersection seen from above, paved in violet-grey stone and asphalt, with building rooftops and blocks around the edges as walls, planters, benches and crates as small obstacles, glowing streetlights

lapras-lagoon.name: Seafoam Lagoon
lapras-lagoon.place: a calm, sunlit turquoise sea with soft white ripples and shimmering light
lapras-lagoon.layout: a tropical lagoon arena: a big pale-sand island and sandbars in the middle, clear turquoise shallows and deeper blue water around the edges and in a few channels, rocks, a few palm trees and beach umbrellas as obstacles

glastrier-ice-field.name: Crown Tundra Ice Field
glastrier-ice-field.place: a frozen tundra with tall pale-blue ice spires and crystals, snowy pines, snow on the ground and a cold blue sky with pink clouds
glastrier-ice-field.layout: a snowy tundra field, open packed snow in the middle, clusters of tall ice spires, ice crystals and snowy pines around the edges and a few inside as obstacles, frozen ponds

cresselia-moonlit-sky.name: Crescent Isle
cresselia-moonlit-sky.place: a starry night sky with shooting stars above a glowing pale-blue planet rim, deep violet and blue
cresselia-moonlit-sky.layout: a floating moonstone island of pale glowing blue-white rock in a starry violet void: the void around it is impassable, a wide flat moonstone floor with a few pale crystal pillars and moon-rock outcrops as obstacles

herdier-temple.name: Stone Stair Temple
herdier-temple.place: sunlit old ruins: wide pale pink sandstone stairs and walls, a small red lantern, warm light and a blue sky with white clouds
herdier-temple.layout: an ancient pink sandstone temple courtyard like a gym battle floor: a large flat paved stone floor with a faint circular emblem, stepped stone walls and stairs around the edges, a few stone pillars and red lanterns as cover

growlithe-meadow.name: Kanto Meadow
growlithe-meadow.place: a green rolling meadow with round trees and hills under a bright sky
growlithe-meadow.layout: a grassy meadow arena of short green grass and dirt paths, round leafy trees and bushes around the edges and a few inside, patches of tall grass, a small pond
